items.summary: BYD is overhauling its Seagull electric vehicle for a second generation, aiming to compete with new entry-level EVs. The updated model, potentially named the 'Great Seagull,' will feature a larger design with an immersive cockpit, ambient lighting, and power-adjustable front seats with massage functions. Regulatory filings indicate the new car will be 4,205 mm long with a 95 kW motor, replacing the current 55 kW unit. While BYD has not confirmed all details, reports suggest the rear-mounted motor will increase front trunk space. The vehicle is expected to launch in China by the end of 2026.
items.title: BYD Overhauls Cheapest EV With Luxury Features and Larger Size

items.summary: An author argues that the global shortage of diesel and jet fuel is a complex economic issue rooted in the difficulty of extracting heavy and sour oils, rather than solely the result of geopolitical conflicts like those in the Middle East or Ukraine. The analysis suggests that since around 2005, per capita consumption of these fuels has plateaued or declined because the world's output of conventional, easy-to-extract oil peaked. The author contends that higher long-term prices for diesel and jet fuel are necessary to incentivize investment in expensive heavy oil reserves. However, this would likely increase costs for food production and transportation, potentially squeezing household budgets and pushing economies toward recession. The author proposes that societies may need to transform by reducing reliance on these fuels, shortening supply chains, and lowering overall consumption to adapt to a future dominated by more expensive energy sources.
items.title: Author argues global diesel shortage stems from heavy oil economics, not just geopolitical conflicts

items.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump and heads of six major technology companies signed a voluntary accord committing frontier AI developers to a four-layer safety system involving internal monitoring, external audits, and board oversight. While experts like Gaurav Vasu and Vaibhav Tare acknowledged the step as positive, they highlighted the lack of enforcement mechanisms and consequences for non-compliance. Critics argue that without statutory backing or penalties, the framework risks becoming a procedural exercise rather than ensuring meaningful safety, especially given the inherent conflict of interest when companies set their own benchmarks. The agreement aims to establish common practices but remains subject to debate regarding its effectiveness in a competitive market.
items.title: Trump and Tech Leaders Sign Voluntary AI Safety Pact Amid Expert Skepticism

items.summary: Tzika Manes, an Israeli passenger, recounted how he and two others restrained a flydubai co-pilot accused of attempting to crash the aircraft. The passengers used corded headphones to subdue the attacker while another managed to level the plane. The flight was diverted to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, after the incident. Netanyahu praised the intervention, stating it saved lives.
items.title: Flydubai Passengers Restrain Alleged Attacker During Flight

items.summary: The trailer for the horror-comedy film 'Nayyi Navelli' features Yami Gautam Dhar as a bride with a secret. Directed by Balaji Mohan and based on Himanshu Sharma's story, the movie also stars Addinath M Kothare and includes music by GV Prakash Kumar. It is scheduled for release on October 16.
items.title: Nayyi Navelli Trailer Reveals Horror-Comedy Starring Yami Gautam Dhar

items.summary: A bipartisan group of senators announced a deal designed to accelerate the federal permitting process for major energy projects, including renewables, fossil fuels, and transmission lines. The package includes provisions to streamline reviews and strengthen FERC's authority. However, the deal faces uncertainty regarding its passage in Congress, as President Donald Trump's position on advancing permits for solar and wind remains unclear. Senate Democrats have made their support contingent on ending the current blockade and securing protections against future administrations. The legislation is scheduled for a vote after the November midterm elections, mirroring a previous 2024 attempt that ultimately failed.
items.title: Senators Strike Bipartisan Deal to Speed Up Federal Energy Permitting

items.summary: The government reduced export duties on diesel and aviation turbine fuel effective October 1, while keeping petrol levies unchanged. This fortnightly adjustment aims to ensure domestic fuel availability amid the West Asia conflict. Previous export rates were higher, but domestic excise duties remain unaffected. The review process began in late March 2026.
items.title: Government Slashes Export Duties on Diesel and ATF

items.summary: The Election Commission of India extended the Special Intensive Revision schedule for electoral rolls in Andhra Pradesh and Meghalaya following a full bench meeting. New dates were announced for the notice phase, disposal of claims, and final publication in both states. The Commission stated that major decisions were taken unanimously, addressing recent political controversy regarding SIR-linked orders.
items.title: Election Commission Extends SIR Schedule in Andhra Pradesh and Meghalaya

items.summary: Senators introduced the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 to reform the electric grid. The bill aims to streamline permitting, strengthen federal backstops for siting major lines, and ensure costs follow benefits. Supporters, including Sen. Lee and Patrick Hughes of Americans for a Clean Energy Grid, argue the legislation addresses a broken process that has stalled projects for years.
items.title: Senators Introduce Bipartisan Bill to Reform Electric Grid

items.summary: A journalist describes a glassmaker in Damascus working in 100 degree heat, shaping cups and lamps with techniques unchanged for decades. While the civil war has ended, the economy struggles with high inflation, making even glass a luxury. The empty shop highlights the contrast between the enduring craft and the current economic reality.
items.title: Glassmaker in Damascus Works Amidst Economic Struggles

items.summary: EL PAÍS invites readers to subscribe for unlimited access to its latest news. The service offers a trial subscription priced at €1 for the first month, allowing users to follow all updates without restrictions.
items.title: EL PAÍS Offers One-Euro Subscription Trial for Unlimited News Access

items.summary: Yaniv, an Israeli passenger, recounted to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu how he and others subdued a pilot on a flydubai flight. Yaniv stated he entered the cockpit, restrained the man, and pulled the controls to stabilize the aircraft after it began nosediving. The flight diverted to Saudi Arabia before returning to Ben Gurion Airport with around 180 passengers. Netanyahu praised the passengers and crew for preventing a disaster.
items.title: Passenger Tells Netanyahu How He Subdued Pilot on Flydubai Flight

items.summary: California has enacted Senate Bill 1213 to address high costs and lack of pricing transparency in the electric truck market. The law requires manufacturers to share pricing data with state agencies starting in 2027 to improve incentive programs and financing options. Currently, electric trucks cost significantly more upfront than diesel models, and pricing opacity hinders bank lending. The bill aims to foster a more competitive market and support the state's clean energy transition goals, despite ongoing challenges from federal policies and high diesel prices.
items.title: California Passes Bill to Boost Electric Truck Market Transparency
